title: Law Third Pre Independence Law Commission 1862 Sir John Romilly
definition: The Third Law Commission of India, established in 1862 under the chairmanship of Sir John Romilly, was a British-appointed body tasked with codifying substantive law for India, primarily focusing on the law of succession and contract.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for understanding the evolution of the Indian Legal System, the process of codification during the British Raj, and the historical roots of modern Indian civil laws.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Law Third Pre Independence Law Commission 1862 Sir John Romilly.
